title: My Aunt Has A Key To YOURS 🔑
description:
My aunt Lou has been the locksmith on our court for forty years, and she has a key to all twelve houses. Every night at midnight, you can hear her using them.

Last month I moved out of her house and into number seven. I never gave her a key. She has one anyway, and every morning my sneakers are wet.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
